purpose: Single source of truth for internal realpass authorities. Modules are separable for development/diagnosis but the accepted release profile is locked and all-or-nothing.

internalCore.reason: Lifecycle, serialization and shared utility substrate; it must not itself impose gameplay effects.

modules.isolationContract: A development build may suspend body progression for diagnosis without deleting saved state. The accepted release profile always enables the body authority.
Development isolation must clear transient bleeding/pain/impairment effects without destroying retained model state. Release keeps injury authority enabled.
A development build may leave native combat authoritative while realpass combat is isolated. Release always enables the accepted physical combat authority.

Development isolation adds no realpass interception/wear. Release always uses accepted physical protection rules; ordinary clothing never becomes generic armor. Vanilla Outfit convenience may equip actual carried clothing, but no separate cosmetic/transmog authority may determine protection.

The current authored scope is narrow: cyberware/metal hit structure can receive distinct chrome damage and require mechanical care. It is not a generic cyberware rebalance and future physiology additions require explicit model justification.

Presentation can be isolated for development without changing simulation. Biology reuses the stock cyberware_equip anatomy shell, Cyberware remains an internal equipment mode, detail bars read authoritative state only, and no source-mod runtime owns presentation behavior. Mod Settings may expose status/ledger text and explicitly accepted presentation/accessibility booleans, but are never simulation authority.
Diagnostics are explicit attended-development behavior only. No background watcher, recorder, scheduled task or helper service is permitted.

releaseRules: The accepted gameplay/presentation authorities ship enabled together as one authored experience.
Internal module gates are development tools, not player preferences.
Every retained gameplay feature maps to exactly one owning realpass module.
Presentation may read simulation state but must not become a simulation authority.
Vanilla Outfit convenience may be retained only as physical loadout application over actual carried equipment; a parallel transmog/protection authority is out of scope.
Mod Settings presence/ledger and accepted binary presentation/accessibility preferences may not alter core simulation authority or balance.
Out-of-scope inherited features are absent from the distributed runtime.
Source/reference gameplay mods are forbidden from owned-runtime manifests.
Development activation gates stay closed in canonical source and are opened only in an immutable exact candidate until native acceptance is satisfied.
